info.name: Catalog Service
info.description: REST APIs for app configuration, active category listing, static CMS pages (e.g. privacy, terms, help, faq), and user-facing support tickets.

request.description: Splash / Update validation: returns minimum app version, force update flag, and maintenance message.
Fetch active expert categories for dashboard strips, search filters, and onboarding dropdowns.

variable.description: Supported slugs: privacy, terms, help, faq, about

request.description: Retrieve static CMS page HTML/Markdown by slug. Used for Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, Help Centre, FAQ, About Us screens.

query.description: Filter by status: open | in_progress | resolved | closed

request.description:
Returns the authenticated user's support tickets, newest first. Optionally filter by status.

**Figma screen**: No Support Tickets (empty state), Support Tickets (list view).

**Response** `{ success, message, data: { items, page, limit, total } }`

response.name: 200 - Tickets listed

request.description:
Submit a new support ticket. Available for both customer and expert roles.

**Figma screen**: Create New Ticket, Ticket Created - Successful.

**categories**: `billing` | `account` | `technical` | `expert_issue` | `consultation` | `other`

**Response**: 201 with ticket object.
